description: The Geo-Informatics Data Center for Marine and Coastal resources of the Thai Department of Marine and Coastal Resources is a web map of coastal and marine layers with filters and legends. The layers seen on the page include the 2024 (Buddhist year 2567) coastal status by province, for example Chumphon and Ranong, islands, a Land Bridge project layer, and bathymetry and depth contours from the Department of Mineral Resources, among others on the department's coastal resources. The department also runs a provincial marine and coastal resource management system that presents the data for each coastal province from Trat to Satun, and a data catalogue. Access to the map is free and public; no licence is stated on the page read. Caveats: the page is in Thai, the map loads its layers by script, and download options are not shown on the page read. Coverage is the coast and seas of Thailand. It supports coastal erosion and storm surge exposure analysis for ports, roads and other coastal infrastructure, and planning of mangrove and other green and blue defences; related records are the CEREMA national coastal erosion indicator and the Danish Kystdata coastal measurements.
